summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatter "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title), which passes a single two-item tuple. rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal, returning True or False. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title). Tests added: test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, test_set_window_title in tests/test_console.py (returns early on legacy consoles), and test_control_set_window_title in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. CHANGELOG.md gained an Added bullet under Unreleased linking PR 2200. Nothing was run, per instructions; all verification was by reading. Nothing was committed. Open point: the CHANGELOG link uses the full GitHub URL, which may need to match the repo's existing link style.
